contexts.text: They want to... be preferred to all others. Described.
If he can thus prefer himself to others, he is in the delight of his life.
The perception that good from proprium cannot but have... a preference of self before others; consequently contempt for others.

Truths and affections are elevated, when the things of eternal life... are preferred before those of (this) life... The contrary happens when he prefers (the latter before the former). AC 4104:4. AC 4104:5.
In Heaven all are as equals... but still the one prefers the other to himself as he excels in intelligence and wisdom.
That a state of marriage is to be preferred to one of celibacy. Explained.
